note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. New wave-2 template distilled from a field pattern; prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows the pending purchase-order queue with the matched quote and what to watch for on each
cases.prompt: What's in my PO queue this morning?

cases.onepager_bullet: Reads each purchase order into structured header and line fields with nothing inferred
cases.prompt: Read PO-4471 and pull out the order details.

cases.onepager_bullet: Validates prices, terms, ship-to and contact against the accepted quote with a per-line price tolerance
must_include: $410 on the PO vs $395 on the quote

cases.onepager_bullet: Catches incompatible pairings, missing mandatory kits and region-restricted configurations before entry
cases.prompt: Check the product configuration on the Coho Refining order.
must_include: Never enter this order with the wrong configuration

cases.onepager_bullet: Classifies region, order type, order class and sales channel from the PO and the quote
cases.prompt: What order type, class and sales channel should PO-4471 go in as?

cases.onepager_bullet: Prepares a draft sales order at quote prices with every exception listed for the specialist
cases.prompt: Prepare the sales order for PO-4471 so I can enter it.
must_include: nothing was submitted to the ERP

cases.onepager_bullet: Reviews the whole queue so ready orders go in first and every exception has a named reason
cases.prompt: Across the whole queue, which orders are ready to enter and which need a fix?

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
